interpretation.endpoint: directly observed coordinate5, threshold0, predeclared by design; no learned latent manifold or PCA alignment tested
interpretation.intervention: remove source outgoing cross terms at every future update; retain own activity equation and self history; factual/disconnected share innovations and fixed factual origin side
interpretation.support_and_parameter_ownership: Only known_support receives the simulator adjacency. Four native lanes discover support from inner-training trials0–8 (one within-trial history apiece), excluding9–11. All fit penalties/scalers/noise use outer-training0–11 only, with inner-validation9–11; final coefficients refit on outer training0–11; evaluation trials12–23. Learned coefficients and noise are estimated rather than simulator-provided.
interpretation.native_discovery_configuration: max_lag1; alpha0.01; beta0.005; conventional1000 permutations; fast0 uses complete circular shifts; support quorum0.5 across9 trials; history contexts256 vs1024 and burn-in128; same trial_length1152, target/cutoffs/fitting data across paired history study
interpretation.null_uncertainty: Every current method/report has0 false-nomination seed events in1 planned/evaluated null seed; exact one-sided95% Clopper–Pearson upper0.95. Event is any false candidate or group in either direction within a seed. It is per-method and not simultaneous across methods, not neuron FDR, and does not establish specificity or calibrated nomination.
interpretation.topk_eligibility: Both driver directions have positive neurons at effect threshold0.1 and are available. Every current positive mean uses1 fully eligible seed. Null directions have no intervention-positive neurons; null top-k and nomination recall remain null/unavailable despite nonzero factual events in history-null0→1.
interpretation.topk_tie_rule: Expected recall under random ordering of exact score ties; all-zero six-neuron ranking returns1/6 instead of a successful driver nomination; candidate group scores are not included in neuron top-k.
interpretation.metric_aggregation: Reported effect MAE averages absolute error over8 interventions×12 heldout origins. Directional effect MAE averages absolute error of direction-mean effects and is a different aggregation. Positive summary top-k averages the two eligible directions within seed and then seeds.
interpretation.reproduction_scope: Current run reuses Nov15 raw seed20, exact configurations, training and evaluation-origin fingerprints, and paired oracle outputs; this is same-seed reproduction/diagnostic evidence, no new confirmation. Conventional permutation randomness is explicitly not fully controlled, and current smoke c-GC* selects one endpoint edge absent in Nov15; this causes top-k0.5 vs1/6 and effectMAE0.08707682291666667 vs0.14697265625.
interpretation.old_known_support_three_seed_scope: Nov15 archived known_support/empty_support seed20–22,128 trials,8 nodes and512 rollouts are historical evidence only; none of the three current supplied native reports re-executes that three-seed configuration.
interpretation.comparison_to_old_latent_benchmark: This favorable additive-tanh lag-one fully observed mechanism and observed coordinate endpoint do not replace or overturn the old partially observed bistable/PCA benchmark or test hidden-state robustness. No cross-estimand performance contrast or biological necessity conclusion is justified.
interpretation.statistics: Paired effects are descriptive. With1 independent raw process seed, no between-seed SD, process-level CI, p-value, or standardized effect size is estimable; trials, directions and method lanes cannot supply substitute seed counts. The exact null CP bound is reported separately under its fixed-rule and seed-independence assumptions.
interpretation.verification_limits: Metrics and native decisions were audited from frozen report/cell/NPZ/JSON artifacts. Inputs and oracle outputs were compared by stored fingerprints and exact oracle equality; raw generators were not rerun. Factual Brier is carried from artifacts because per-origin factual observed event labels are not separately serialized; direction-level event counts are retained.
